name: Jiu Bing Cheng Hui
source:
Rabies erupts without warning, rupturing the young policeman’s placid existence. Condemned by this incurable, lifelong affliction, he confronts an agonizing ultimatum: surrender his badge to reality’s demands, or bury his sickness to hunt the truth behind his infection. This is merely the prologue. When fate beckons him down a path drenched in shadows, his investigation will drag into the light this city’s most sordid secrets—corruption festering through decades, bleeding into the present.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763930/A_Better_Tomorrow/]Steam[/url]]
